name: Kidou Shoukan Victoire
original_name: 機動娼艦ヴィクトワール
source:
A prisoner's camp, Port 12. Some girls who are members of a battleship called Victoire are imprisoned there. The boss of the camp is Michael. His mission is to give various sex training to them and make them sex slaves....
